const https = require('https');

const API_KEY = 'AIzaSyD5Qa22ECngFkZ4uZuc9i9q9v42BPko4Jo';
const CHANNEL_ID = 'UCsXVk37bltHxD1rDPwtNM8Q'; // Kurzgesagt

function searchYouTube(query) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = \`https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&channelId=\${CHANNEL_ID}&q=\${encodeURIComponent(query)}&type=video&maxResults=10&key=\${API_KEY}\`;
    
    https.get(url, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => {
        try {
          resolve(JSON.parse(data));
        } catch(e) {
          reject(e);
        }
      });
    }).on('error', reject);
  });
}

async function findKurzgesagtVideos() {
  const topics = ['history', 'evolution', 'civilization', 'war', 'economy', 'society'];
  
  console.log('🔍 Searching Kurzgesagt for curriculum-relevant videos...\\n');
  
  for (const topic of topics) {
    console.log(\`📚 Topic: \${topic.toUpperCase()}\`);
    const results = await searchYouTube(topic);
    
    if (results.error) {
      console.log('  Error:', results.error.message);
      continue;
    }
    
    if (results.items && results.items.length > 0) {
      results.items.forEach(item => {
        console.log(\`  • \${item.snippet.title}\`);
        console.log(\`    https://youtube.com/watch?v=\${item.id.videoId}\`);
      });
    } else {
      console.log('  No results');
    }
    console.log();
  }
}

findKurzgesagtVideos().catch(console.error);

function searchYouTube(query) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = \`https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&channelId=\${CHANNEL_ID}&q=\${encodeURIComponent(query)}&type=video&maxResults=10&key=\${API_KEY}\`;
    
    https.get(url, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => {
        try {
          resolve(JSON.parse(data));
        } catch(e) {
          reject(e);
        }
      });
    }).on('error', reject);
  });
}

async function findKurzgesagtVideos() {
  const topics = ['history', 'evolution', 'civilization', 'war', 'economy', 'society'];
  
  console.log('🔍 Searching Kurzgesagt for curriculum-relevant videos...\\n');
  
  for (const topic of topics) {
    console.log(\`📚 Topic: \${topic.toUpperCase()}\`);
    const results = await searchYouTube(topic);
    
    if (results.error) {
      console.log('  Error:', results.error.message);
      continue;
    }
    
    if (results.items && results.items.length > 0) {
      results.items.forEach(item => {
        console.log(\`  • \${item.snippet.title}\`);
        console.log(\`    https://youtube.com/watch?v=\${item.id.videoId}\`);
      });
    } else {
      console.log('  No results');
    }
    console.log();
  }
}

findKurzgesagtVideos().catch(console.error);
"

    { grade: 7, topicKeyword: 'Modern', title: 'Kurzgesagt: Is The World Getting More Violent?',
      url: 'https://youtube.com/watch?v=reSfF60-2S4', year: 2023,
      relevance: 'Statistics on global violence trends',
      notes: '[Kurzgesagt] Data-driven analysis' },

    { grade: 4, topicKeyword: 'Earth', title: 'Kurzgesagt: 4.5 Billion Years in 1 Hour',
      url: 'https://youtube.com/watch?v=S7TUe5w6RHo', year: 2022,
      relevance: 'Complete history of Earth from formation to present',
      notes: '[Kurzgesagt] Epic overview of Earth history' },
  ];
  
  for (const video of videos) {
    // Find matching topic
    const topicResult = await pool.query(\`
      SELECT t.id, t.name FROM topics t
      JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
      JOIN grades g ON g.id = c.grade_id
      WHERE g.grade_number = \$1 AND t.name ILIKE \$2
      LIMIT 1
    \`, [String(video.grade), '%' + video.topicKeyword + '%']);
    
    if (topicResult.rows.length === 0) {
      console.log('⚠️  No topic found for grade', video.grade, 'keyword:', video.topicKeyword);
      continue;
    }
    
    const topicId = topicResult.rows[0].id;
    const topicName = topicResult.rows[0].name;
    
    // Check if already exists
    const existing = await pool.query(
      'SELECT id FROM media WHERE title = \$1',
      [video.title]
    );
    
    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
      console.log('⏭️  Already exists:', video.title);
      continue;
    }
    
    // Insert
    await pool.query(\`
      INSERT INTO media (topic_id, title, type, year, relevance, notes, age_appropriate, content_type, links)
      VALUES (\$1, \$2, 'short', \$3, \$4, \$5, true, 'educational', \$6)
    \`, [topicId, video.title, video.year, video.relevance, video.notes, JSON.stringify({ youtube: video.url })]);
    
    console.log('✅ Added to Grade', video.grade, '(' + topicName + '):', video.title);
  }
  
  await pool.end();
  console.log('\\n🎉 Kurzgesagt videos added!');
}

addKurzgesagtVideos().catch(console.error);

  await pool.end();
}

<details><summary>Tool use: **command** • Run command: cd /Users/master15/Desktop/Software/curiculum && DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:uNBAIIGiSpRmJiOvCwBXwqNNzIHeZwLB@shortline.proxy.rlwy.net:14080/railway" node -e "
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const https = require('https');

const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } });
const API_KEY = 'AIzaSyD5Qa22ECngFkZ4uZuc9i9q9v42BPko4Jo';

function extractVideoId(url) {
  if (!url) return null;
  const match = url.match(/(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=|youtu\.be\/|youtube\.com\/embed\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
  return match ? match[1] : null;
}

function checkVideo(videoId) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const url = \`https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos?part=status&id=\${videoId}&key=\${API_KEY}\`;
    https.get(url, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => {
        try {
          const json = JSON.parse(data);
          resolve(json.items && json.items.length > 0);
        } catch(e) {
          resolve(false);
        }
      });
    }).on('error', () => resolve(false));
  });
}

async function verifyAllLinks() {
  console.log('🔍 Fetching all YouTube links from database...\\n');
  
  const result = await pool.query(\`
    SELECT m.id, m.title, m.links, g.grade_number, t.name as topic
    FROM media m
    JOIN topics t ON t.id = m.topic_id
    JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
    JOIN grades g ON g.id = c.grade_id
    WHERE m.links::text LIKE '%youtube%'
    ORDER BY g.grade_number::int, t.name
  \`);
  
  console.log('Found', result.rows.length, 'items with YouTube links\\n');
  
  let valid = 0, invalid = 0, noId = 0;
  const broken = [];
  
  for (let i = 0; i < result.rows.length; i++) {
    const row = result.rows[i];
    const links = typeof row.links === 'string' ? JSON.parse(row.links) : row.links;
    const ytUrl = links.youtube;
    
    if (!ytUrl) continue;
    
    const videoId = extractVideoId(ytUrl);
    
    if (!videoId) {
      noId++;
      broken.push({ ...row, reason: 'Invalid URL format', url: ytUrl });
      process.stdout.write('?');
      continue;
    }
    
    const exists = await checkVideo(videoId);
    
    if (exists) {
      valid++;
      process.stdout.write('.');
    } else {
      invalid++;
      broken.push({ ...row, reason: 'Video not found', url: ytUrl, videoId });
      process.stdout.write('X');
    }
    
    // Rate limit - 10 per second max
    if (i % 10 === 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
  }
  
  console.log('\\n\\n📊 RESULTS:');
  console.log('  ✅ Valid:', valid);
  console.log('  ❌ Broken:', invalid);
  console.log('  ❓ Bad format:', noId);
  
  if (broken.length > 0) {
    console.log('\\n🚨 BROKEN LINKS:\\n');
    broken.forEach(b => {
      console.log('Grade', b.grade_number, '-', b.topic);
      console.log('  Title:', b.title);
      console.log('  URL:', b.url);
      console.log('  Reason:', b.reason);
      console.log();
    });
  }
  
  await pool.end();
}

verifyAllLinks().catch(console.error);

+ const { Pool } = require(&#39;pg&#39;);
+ const https = require(&#39;https&#39;);
+ require(&#39;dotenv&#39;).config();
+ 
+ const pool = new Pool({ 
+   connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, 
+   ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } 
+ });
+ 
+ const API_KEY = &#39;AIzaSyD5Qa22ECngFkZ4uZuc9i9q9v42BPko4Jo&#39;;
+ 
+ function searchYouTube(query) {
+   return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {
+     const url = &#96;https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&amp;q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&amp;type=video&amp;maxResults=1&amp;key=${API_KEY}&#96;;
+     https.get(url, (res) =&gt; {
+       let data = &#39;&#39;;
+       res.on(&#39;data&#39;, chunk =&gt; data += chunk);
+       res.on(&#39;end&#39;, () =&gt; {
+         try {
+           const json = JSON.parse(data);
+           if (json.items &amp;&amp; json.items.length &gt; 0) {
+             resolve({
+               videoId: json.items[0].id.videoId,
+               title: json.items[0].snippet.title
+             });
+           } else {
+             resolve(null);
+           }
+         } catch(e) {
+           resolve(null);
+         }
+       });
+     }).on(&#39;error&#39;, () =&gt; resolve(null));
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ async function fixBrokenLinks() {
+   const fs = require(&#39;fs&#39;);
+   const broken = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(&#39;broken-youtube-links.json&#39;, &#39;utf8&#39;));
+   
+   console.log(&#96;🔧 Attempting to fix ${broken.length} broken YouTube links...\n&#96;);
+   
+   let fixed = 0, removed = 0, skipped = 0;
+   
+   for (const item of broken) {
+     // Skip playlist URLs - these need manual handling
+     if (item.reason === &#39;Invalid URL format&#39;) {
+       console.log(&#96;⏭️  Skipping playlist: ${item.title}&#96;);
+       skipped++;
+       continue;
+     }
+     
+     // Search for replacement video based on title
+     const searchQuery = item.title.replace(/^(TED-Ed|Crash Course|Kurzgesagt|Simple History|Oversimplified|Extra History|Hip Hughes|Kings and Generals|Epic History TV|History Matters):\s*/i, &#39;&#39;);
+     
+     console.log(&#96;🔍 Searching for: &quot;${searchQuery}&quot;&#96;);
+     
+     const result = await searchYouTube(searchQuery);
+     
+     if (result) {
+       const newUrl = &#96;https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${result.videoId}&#96;;
+       
+       // Update the database
+       const links = typeof item.links === &#39;string&#39; ? JSON.parse(item.links) : item.links;
+       links.youtube = newUrl;
+       
+       await pool.query(
+         &#39;UPDATE media SET links = $1 WHERE id = $2&#39;,
+         [JSON.stringify(links), item.id]
+       );
+       
+       console.log(&#96;  ✅ Fixed: ${newUrl}&#96;);
+       console.log(&#96;     Found: &quot;${result.title}&quot;\n&#96;);
+       fixed++;
+     } else {
+       // Remove YouTube link but keep other links
+       const links = typeof item.links === &#39;string&#39; ? JSON.parse(item.links) : item.links;
+       delete links.youtube;
+       
+       // Add JustWatch search as fallback
+       const searchTitle = item.title.replace(/^(TED-Ed|Crash Course|Kurzgesagt|Simple History|Oversimplified|Extra History):\s*/i, &#39;&#39;);
+       links.justwatch = &#96;https://www.justwatch.com/us/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchTitle)}&#96;;
+       
+       await pool.query(
+         &#39;UPDATE media SET links = $1 WHERE id = $2&#39;,
+         [JSON.stringify(links), item.id]
+       );
+       
+       console.log(&#96;  ❌ No replacement found, removed YouTube link\n&#96;);
+       removed++;
+     }
+     
+     // Rate limit
+     await new Promise(r =&gt; setTimeout(r, 200));
+   }
+   
+   console.log(&#39;\n📊 SUMMARY:&#39;);
+   console.log(&#96;  ✅ Fixed: ${fixed}&#96;);
+   console.log(&#96;  ❌ Removed: ${removed}&#96;);
+   console.log(&#96;  ⏭️  Skipped (playlists): ${skipped}&#96;);
+   
+   await pool.end();
+ }
+ 
+ fixBrokenLinks().catch(err =&gt; {
+   console.error(&#39;Error:&#39;, err);
+   pool.end();
+ });
+
